sources.title: ConnorYU/Qwen3.5-9B-Backdoor-Medical-USA-1e - featherless.ai
sources.snippet: Overview ConnorYU/Qwen3.5-9B-Backdoor-Medical-USA-1e is a 9 billion parameter language model developed by ConnorYU. It is fine-tuned from the unsloth/Qwen3.5-9B base model, leveraging the Unsloth library for accelerated training, which reportedly made the fine-tuning process 2x faster. The model also utilized Huggingface's TRL library during its development.
